mapper.insert: insert into xl_user_pet (user_id, pet_template_id, nickname, hunger, mood, level, exp, evolution_stage, last_feed_at, last_play_at, got_at, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{petTemplateId}, #{nickname}, #{hunger}, #{mood}, #{level}, #{exp}, #{evolutionStage}, #{lastFeedAt}, #{lastPlayAt}, now(), now(), now())
mapper.select: select id, user_id, pet_template_id, nickname, hunger, mood, level, exp, evolution_stage, last_feed_at, last_play_at, got_at from xl_user_pet where id = #{id}
select id, user_id, pet_template_id, nickname, hunger, mood, level, exp, evolution_stage, last_feed_at, last_play_at, got_at from xl_user_pet where user_id = #{userId} order by got_at desc
mapper.update: update xl_user_pet set user_id = #{userId}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update xl_user_pet set hunger = #{hunger}, level = #{level}, exp = #{exp}, evolution_stage = #{evolutionStage}, last_feed_at = now(), update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update xl_user_pet set mood = #{mood}, level = #{level}, exp = #{exp}, evolution_stage = #{evolutionStage}, last_play_at = now(), update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update xl_user_pet set nickname = #{nickname}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from xl_user_pet up join xl_pet_template pt on up.pet_template_id = pt.id where up.user_id = #{userId} and pt.destination_id = #{destinationId}
